topic: A twin-free answer to Problem 30 and the complete spectral multiplicity classification of Theta(3,3,r) for r >= 2
title: A twin-free answer to Alfuraidan–Khan–Sauras-Altuzarra, arXiv:2610.26875v1, Section 9, Problem 30 (p. 27): a spectral extension of Knor–Sedlar–Škrekovski (2022)

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We answer Problem 30 in Section 9 (p. 27) of Alfuraidan, Khan and Sauras-Altuzarra, Metric dimension and maximum eigenvalue multiplicity of graph Laplacians, arXiv:2610.26875v1, and extend the metric-dimension classification of Knor, Sedlar and Škrekovski (2022) to a classification of both maximum spectral multiplicities for Theta(3,3,r), for every r >= 2. For every integer k >= 1, the theta graph with edge lengths 3, 3, 6k+4 is connected and twin-free, has metric dimension and maximum Laplacian eigenvalue multiplicity two, and has simple signless spectrum. Its only repeated Laplacian eigenvalues are 1 and 3, each double. Distinct orders give pairwise nonisomorphic examples. For r >= 3, repeated eigenvalues are classified modulo six; r = 2 has a separate quadratic repeated factor. Attaching an equal pendant path at every vertex of two known base graphs also gives twin-free infinite families in both separation directions.
summary: Theta(3,3,6k+4), k >= 1, answers Problem 30 affirmatively. The complete Theta(3,3,r), r >= 2, classification extends the r >= 10 scope: metric dimension is three at r = 3,5 and two otherwise. Exactly one equality holds precisely for r = 2 or r congruent to 4 modulo six, always in the Laplacian direction. Both hold precisely for r >= 6 in residues 0,1,3. The other cases satisfy neither. The signless-only direction is impossible within this subfamily. This completely answers the restriction of Problem 29 to two edge lengths equal to three. The particular signless multiplicity at 2 is the specialization of Paone–Paone (2026), Corollary 8.1. The metric-dimension results are credited to Knor–Sedlar–Škrekovski (2022). Corollary 6 combines the source's base examples with rooted-product results of Jannesari (2023), Feng–Wang (2012) and Cardoso–Martins–Robbiano–Rojo (2013): attaching any positive-length path to each vertex of K_{1,3,3} gives (dim,mm_L,mm_Q)=(4,4,5), while K_2 join (2K_2) gives (3,2,3); all resulting graphs are twin-free. The modular lower bound of Belmonte–Fomin–Golovach–Ramanujan (2016) is reproved. Periodicity at the particular eigenvalues 1,3 also follows from Bahmani–Kiani (2015/2016); exclusion of all other repeated eigenvalues uses the written recurrence argument.
